text:
Jo: Hey team — found an ancient owl sticker behind the coffee stash. Is this a relic or am I supposed to start a ritual? :owl:
Emma: Relic. Also highly covetable. Please don't stick it on a laptop until we vote. :eyes:
Ravi: Vote here: do we make this the official office mascot or hide it in the supply closet? 1) Mascot 2) Hide 3) Sacrifice to the copier
Tegan: Mascot. We need more lore. Suggestion: each new hire has to do the Owl Oath and get a sticker placement photo. :camera_with_flash:
Maya: Oath text draft: "I will protect the Keurig, honor the snack cabinet, and never unplug the dev machine." Thoughts?
Emma: Replace 'dev machine' with 'build box' — sounds more majestic. :sunglasses:
Jo: Also thinking of a low-effort competition: Sticker Olympics. Best placement wins a $5 coffee card. Short, silly, and a good onboarding tradition.
Ravi: Love it. Rules? No permanent glue, no sticking to monitors, must be visible in a team photo. Judges: me, Tegan, and OpsBot (bot logs timestamp).
OpsBot: Automated reminder set: "Sticker Olympics sign-up sheet" will ping #random in 2 days. (Reminder created by OpsBot)
Maya: Can we get custom stickers? Or do a one-off print — or should we use whatever ancient relic Jo found to kick things off?
Emma: Ancient relic as starter prize. Then make stickers from a cleaned scan. Someone good with Illustrator take point? CC @Ravi
Ravi: I can do a quick mock. Happy to run a tiny poll: colors, poses, and a version that says 'I survived my first oncall'.
Tegan: Officially endorsing this. Also: photo evidence required. No photo = disqualification. :camera_with_flash:
Jo: OK sign-up thread incoming. Whoever places the owl on the most creative but office-safe surface wins. May the best stickerer prevail. :tada:
Emma: Also adding a tradition rule: winners get temporary nickname in Slack for a week. Starting name: "Owlkeeper".
Maya: 100% on board. Can we get a little lore entry in the handbook? Tiny bullet in "Culture" about the Owlkeeper initiation?
Ravi: Will draft a one-liner for handbook. "The Owlkeeper tradition: bring stickers, bring snacks, respect the Keurig."
Jo: Love it. Closing ceremony date proposals? Friday lunchtime works for me.
Tegan: Friday lunchtime works. I'll reserve the table.
Emma: I'll order a small sticker sheet sample. If it arrives in time, bonus points for the vintage relic look.
Jo: Perfect. OpsBot will post the sign-up reminder. See you all in Sticker Olympics. :owl: :raised_hands:
